text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making sex discrimination between the two of you functionally impossible to establish. While an all-male panel may reflect poor institutional diversity practices or breach committee composition guidelines, it does not demonstrate bias against you based on sex.

The panel likely prioritized the other candidate's industry experience, interview performance, or specific subfield fit. Raising gender composition as an unsuccessful male applicant competing against another man will appear misdirected and legally baseless, risking harm to your academic reputation.

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on your interview and application to help you prepare for future openings.
